navaids.name: P109
navaids.wreckBoatingEffect: Chart source describes distributed remains as an area considered navigable but to avoid for anchoring, grounding, or bottom fishing.
navaids.description:
The Remains of P109
Very little remains of this old boat which has been slowly slipping into decay on the shoreline at Bosham Harbour for many years. It has been the subject of countless photographs, paintings and has appeared on greeting cards.
